; D += BC bytes from HL: an 8-bit sum with end-around carry
fn_cksum:
        ld      a,b
        or      c
        ret     z
        ld      a,d
        add     a,(hl)
        adc     a,0
        ld      d,a
        inc     hl
        dec     bc
        jr      fn_cksum

; BC bytes from HL, SLIP-escaped
fn_slip:
        ld      a,b
        or      c
        ret     z
        ld      a,(hl)
        cp      SLIP_END
        jr      z,fn_slipe
        cp      SLIP_ESC
        jr      z,fn_slipx
        call    fn_putc
        jr      fn_slipn
fn_slipe:
        ld      a,SLIP_ESC
        call    fn_putc
        ld      a,SLIP_ESC_END
        call    fn_putc
        jr      fn_slipn
fn_slipx:
        ld      a,SLIP_ESC
        call    fn_putc
        ld      a,SLIP_ESC_ESC
        call    fn_putc
fn_slipn:
        inc     hl
        dec     bc
        jr      fn_slip

        ld      de,lat

        call    jget

        ld      de,lng

fetch_end:

jget:
        push    hl
        call    strlen                  ; the query is the whole payload
        pop     hl
        ld      (rq_query+RQ_PAY),hl
        ld      (rq_query+RQ_PLEN),bc
        ld      hl,rq_query
        call    fn_call
        ret     nz
        ld      hl,rq_status            ; the value is waiting to be read
        call    fn_call
        ret     nz
        ld      hl,(nstat+NS_AVAIL)
        ld      a,h
        or      l
        jr      z,jget_none             ; not found: nothing waits
        ld      de,VALSZ-1
        or      a
        sbc     hl,de
        add     hl,de
        jr      c,jget1
        ex      de,hl
jget1:
        ld      (rq_read+RQ_AUX1),hl
        ld      hl,rq_read
        call    fn_call
        ret     nz
        ld      hl,val                  ; end it at BC, then drop the
        add     hl,bc                   ;   line feed (and any CR)
        ld      (hl),0
jget2:
        ld      a,b
        or      c
        jr      z,jget3
        dec     hl
        ld      a,(hl)
        cp      ' '
        jr      nc,jget3
        ld      (hl),0
        dec     bc
        jr      jget2
jget3:
        xor     a                       ; Z: found
        ret
jget_none:
        inc     a                       ; NZ
        ret

open_json:
        push    hl
        call    strlen
        pop     hl
        ld      (rq_open+RQ_PAY),hl
        ld      (rq_open+RQ_PLEN),bc
        ld      hl,rq_open              ; open: GET the document
        call    fn_call
        ret     nz
        ld      hl,rq_parser            ; the channel's parser: JSON
        call    fn_call
        ret     nz
        ld      hl,rq_parse             ; read and parse the whole reply

place:

        add     hl,de                   ; 0 to 3600
        ld      c,50
        call    div16_8                 ; 0 to 72

        jr      c,place1
        ld      a,MAP_W-1
place1:

        ld      hl,lat

        ex      de,hl
        ld      hl,900
        or      a
        sbc     hl,de                   ; 0 to 1800
        ld      c,100
        call    div16_8                 ; 0 to 18
        ld      a,l
        cp      MAP_H
        jr      c,place2
        ld      a,MAP_H-1
place2:

rq_open:                                ; mode 4: HTTP GET

        FNBUF   0, 0, 0, 0
rq_parser:                              ; the second field: 1 = JSON

rq_parse:

rq_query:                               ; payload: the JSON Pointer

        FNBUF   0, 0, 0, 0
rq_status:
        FNREQ   DEV_NETWORK, NET_STATUS, F_NONE, 0,0,0,0
        FNBUF   0, 0, nstat, 4
rq_read:
        FNREQ   DEV_NETWORK, NET_READ, F_B12, 0,0,0,0

rq_close:

print_stamp:
        ld      hl,stamp                ; seconds, as a 32-bit number
        call    atou32
        ld      c,60
        call    div32_8
        ld      (sec),a
        call    div32_8                 ; minutes
        ld      (min),a
        ld      c,24
        call    div32_8                 ; hours; days are left
        ld      (hour),a
        ld      hl,(num32)
        ld      de,1970                 ; take away whole years
ps1:
        ld      bc,365
        ld      a,e
        and     3
        jr      nz,ps2
        inc     bc                      ; leap year (1901-2099)
ps2:
        or      a
        sbc     hl,bc
        jr      c,ps3
        inc     de
        jr      ps1
ps3:
        add     hl,bc                   ; HL = day of the year, from 0
        ld      (year),de
        ld      ix,mdays                ; then whole months
        ld      b,1
ps4:
        ld      e,(ix+0)
        ld      d,0
        ld      a,b
        cp      2
        jr      nz,ps5
        ld      a,(year)
        and     3
        jr      nz,ps5
        inc     de                      ; 29 days in a leap February
ps5:
        or      a
        sbc     hl,de
        jr      c,ps6
        inc     ix
        inc     b
        jr      ps4
ps6:
        add     hl,de
        inc     l                       ; days from 1
        push    hl
        push    bc
        ld      hl,(year)
        call    pdec16
        ld      a,'-'
        call    conout
        pop     bc
        ld      a,b
        call    p2dig
        ld      a,'-'
        call    conout
        pop     hl
        ld      a,l
        call    p2dig
        call    pspace
        ld      a,(hour)
        call    p2dig
        ld      a,':'
        call    conout
        ld      a,(min)
        call    p2dig
        ld      a,':'
        call    conout
        ld      a,(sec)
        call    p2dig
        ld      hl,t_utc
        jp      print

asm.text:
ld      a,MODE2                 ; mode 2; PC0-PC2 out, all 0
        out     (PCTRL),a
        in      a,(PORTA)               ; drop a byte latched before
        ret

card_present:
        in      a,(PORTC)
        and     PC_OE|PC_DIR            ; PC1 and PC0 both 0
        ret

; carry once (TICKS - fn_t0) has reached fn_tlim. Uses HL, DE.
fn_expired:
        ld      hl,(TICKS)
        ld      de,(fn_t0)
        or      a
        sbc     hl,de
        ld      de,(fn_tlim)
        or      a
        sbc     hl,de
        ccf
        ret

; the next byte from the ESP32 into A. Keeps BC, DE, HL.
fn_getc:
        in      a,(PORTC)
        and     PC_IBF
        jr      nz,fn_take
        push    hl
        push    de
        ld      hl,(TICKS)
        ld      (fn_t0),hl
fn_getc1:
        in      a,(PORTC)
        and     PC_IBF
        jr      nz,fn_getc2
        call    fn_expired
        jr      nc,fn_getc1
        jp      fn_abort
fn_getc2:
        pop     de
        pop     hl
fn_take:
        in      a,(PORTA)
        ret

; wait until the ESP32 has taken the last byte (/OBF high). Keeps BC DE HL.
fn_txwait:
        in      a,(PORTC)
        and     PC_OBF
        ret     nz
        push    hl
        push    de
        ld      hl,(TICKS)
        ld      (fn_t0),hl
fn_txw1:
        in      a,(PORTC)
        and     PC_OBF
        jr      nz,fn_txw2
        call    fn_expired
        jr      nc,fn_txw1
        jp      fn_abort
fn_txw2:
        pop     de
        pop     hl
        ret

; send A. Keeps BC, DE, HL.
fn_putc:
        push    af
        call    fn_txwait
        pop     af
        out     (PORTA),a
        ret

tick:
        ld      a,(TICKS)
        ld      c,a
tick_wait:
        ld      a,(TICKS)
        cp      c
        jr      z,tick_wait
        ret

ld      hl,rq_mauto             ; field 0: we answer with ATA

...
rq_mauto:                               ; the field must be there

ld      hl,rq_mlock             ; lock the rate at 2400: CONNECT
        call    fn_send                 ;   says 2400 from now on
...
rq_mlock:                               ; lock on, 2400 baud (0960H)
        FNREQ   DEV_SERIAL,MODEM_BAUDRATELOCK,F_B12_B34, 1,0,0x60,0x09
        FNBUF   0, 0, 0, 0

ld      hl,rq_mconf             ; CONFIGURE: 9600 baud, whatever
        call    fn_send                 ;   is asked; no reply at all
...
rq_mconf:
        FNREQ   DEV_SERIAL, MODEM_CONFIGURE, F_NONE, 0,0,0,0
        FNBUF   0, 0, 0, 0

ld      hl,rq_mctl              ; CONTROL: does nothing on the
        call    fn_send                 ;   H89, and says nothing
...
rq_mctl:
        FNREQ   DEV_SERIAL, MODEM_CONTROL, F_NONE, 0,0,0,0
        FNBUF   0, 0, 0, 0

ld      hl,rq_mlstn             ; take calls on port 7803: the
        call    fn_send                 ;   rig's helper calls, and the
        ld      de,mbuf                 ;   modem says RING every 3 s
        ld      bc,MBUFSZ
        call    fn_raw
        ld      hl,mbuf
        call    ptext
...
rq_mlstn:                               ; port 7803 (1E7BH), a word
        FNREQ   DEV_SERIAL, MODEM_LISTEN, F_B12, 0x7B,0x1E,0,0
        FNBUF   0, 0, 0, 0

ld      hl,rq_ml0               ; LISTEN on port 0: a NAK, then

...
rq_ml0:
        FNREQ   DEV_SERIAL, MODEM_LISTEN, F_B12, 0,0,0,0
        FNBUF   0, 0, 0, 0

ld      hl,rq_mdump             ; the traffic log off (field 0)

...
rq_mdump:                               ; the field must be there
        FNREQ   DEV_SERIAL, MODEM_SET_DUMP, F_A1, 0,0,0,0
        FNBUF   0, 0, 0, 0

ld      hl,rq_mstat             ; STATUS: two bare bytes come
        call    fn_send                 ;   back, not a frame
        ld      de,mstat
        ld      bc,2
        call    fn_raw                  ; BC = how many came
        call    crlf
        ld      hl,mstat                ; error bits (0), and C0H+0CH
        call    phexs                   ;   when online, +01H with data
...
rq_mstat:                               ; the field must be there
        FNREQ   DEV_SERIAL, MODEM_STATUS, F_A1, 0,0,0,0
        FNBUF   0, 0, 0, 0

ld      hl,rq_mstat             ; online: CCH
        call    fn_send
        ld      de,mstat
        ld      bc,2
        call    fn_raw

ld      hl,rq_mstat             ; a caller waits: CDH
        call    fn_send
        ld      de,mstat
        ld      bc,2
        call    fn_raw

ld      hl,rq_mstrm             ; STREAM: nine bare bytes, the
        call    fn_send                 ;   Atari POKEY's divisors for
        ld      de,mbuf                 ;   the modem's baud rate
        ld      bc,9
        call    fn_raw
...
rq_mstrm:
        FNREQ   DEV_SERIAL, MODEM_STREAM, F_NONE, 0,0,0,0
        FNBUF   0, 0, 0, 0

ld      hl,rq_mstrm             ; STREAM again: 9600 baud's
        call    fn_send                 ;   divisors now
        ld      de,mbuf
        ld      bc,9
        call    fn_raw

ld      hl,rq_munl              ; no more calls on 7803
        call    fn_send
...
rq_munl:
        FNREQ   DEV_SERIAL, MODEM_UNLISTEN, F_NONE, 0,0,0,0
        FNBUF   0, 0, 0, 0

ld      hl,rq_dial              ; dial the test board, and type
        call    fn_send                 ;   what comes: its greeting,
        call    mtype                   ;   and CONNECT a second later
...
; mtype: type the modem's bytes as they come, until 2 s pass with
; none. BC = how many came in all.
mtype:
        ld      hl,0
        ld      (mcount),hl
mtype1:
        ld      de,mbuf
        ld      bc,MBUFSZ
        call    fn_raw                  ; until 200 ms pass with none
        ld      a,b
        or      c
        jr      z,mtype2                ; 2 s and nothing: that is all
        ld      hl,(mcount)
        add     hl,bc
        ld      (mcount),hl
        ld      hl,mbuf                 ; type them, the unprintable
        call    ptext                   ;   ones as dots
        jr      mtype1
mtype2:
        ld      bc,(mcount)
        ret
mcount: defw    0
...
rq_dial:                                ; one AT command a WRITE
        FNREQ   DEV_SERIAL, MODEM_WRITE, F_NONE, 0,0,0,0
        FNBUF   p_dial, p_diale-p_dial, 0, 0
p_dial: defm    "ATDT127.0.0.1:7801"
        defb    13
p_diale:

ld      hl,rq_mat               ; AT: the modem takes it, but
        call    fn_send                 ;   its OK is never sent
...
rq_mat:

        FNBUF   p_at, 3, 0, 0
p_at:   defm    "AT"
        defb    13

ld      hl,rq_mata              ; ATA answers; what the caller
        call    fn_send                 ;   sent (PING) comes through,
        call    mtype                   ;   CONNECT a second later
...
rq_mata:                                ; just these 4 bytes: ATA, CR
        FNREQ   DEV_SERIAL, MODEM_WRITE, F_NONE, 0,0,0,0
        FNBUF   p_ata, 4, 0, 0
p_ata:  defm    "ATA"
        defb    13

ld      hl,rq_mcpm              ; ATCPM: this build has no CP/M
        call    fn_send                 ;   device, and FujiNet crashes
...
rq_mcpm:
        FNREQ   DEV_SERIAL, MODEM_WRITE, F_NONE, 0,0,0,0
        FNBUF   p_cpm, 6, 0, 0
p_cpm:  defm    "ATCPM"
        defb    13

ld      hl,rq_math              ; so ATH is data too: the board
        call    fn_send                 ;   gets it; the call stays up
        call    mtype
...
rq_math:
        FNREQ   DEV_SERIAL, MODEM_WRITE, F_NONE, 0,0,0,0
        FNBUF   p_ath, 4, 0, 0
p_ath:  defm    "ATH"
        defb    13

ld      hl,rq_mbye              ; the far end must hang up: BYE
        call    fn_send                 ;   to the board; NO CARRIER
        call    mtype
...
rq_mbye:
        FNREQ   DEV_SERIAL, MODEM_WRITE, F_NONE, 0,0,0,0
        FNBUF   p_bye, 4, 0, 0
p_bye:  defm    "BYE"
        defb    13

ld      hl,rq_mline             ; online, a WRITE goes to the
        call    fn_send                 ;   far end: the board echoes
        call    mtype                   ;   it, then shouts it back
...
rq_mline:
        FNREQ   DEV_SERIAL, MODEM_WRITE, F_NONE, 0,0,0,0
        FNBUF   p_line, 6, 0, 0
p_line: defm    "hello"
        defb    13

ld      hl,rq_mplus             ; +++ and a second of quiet: no
        call    fn_send                 ;   OK, it went to the board
        call    mtype
...
rq_mplus:
        FNREQ   DEV_SERIAL, MODEM_WRITE, F_NONE, 0,0,0,0
        FNBUF   p_plus, 3, 0, 0
p_plus: defm    "+++"

ld      hl,rq_mpong             ; answer; the caller hangs up:
        call    fn_send                 ;   NO CARRIER
        call    mtype
...
rq_mpong:
        FNREQ   DEV_SERIAL, MODEM_WRITE, F_NONE, 0,0,0,0
        FNBUF   p_pong, 6, 0, 0
p_pong: defm    "PONG"
        defb    13, 10

        ld      bc,4                    ;   far end, as WRITE's do

ld      hl,rq_read              ; read what STATUS said waits
        call    getwait

...
; HL -> a READ request block. Read what the last STATUS said is
; waiting, a buffer full at most, into buf. HL = buf, BC = count.
getwait:
        push    hl
        pop     ix                      ; IX -> the block
        ld      hl,(nstat+NS_AVAIL)
        ld      de,BUFSZ
        or      a
        sbc     hl,de                   ; more than a buffer?
        add     hl,de
        jr      c,getw1
        ex      de,hl                   ; yes: a buffer full
getw1:
        ld      (ix+RQ_AUX1),l          ; the length to ask for
        ld      (ix+RQ_AUX2),h
        push    ix
        pop     hl
        call    fn_call                 ; BC = what really came
        ld      hl,buf
        ret

; type BC bytes from HL as they are, line ends and all
typeout:
        ld      a,b
        or      c
        ret     z
        ld      a,(hl)
        call    conout
        inc     hl
        dec     bc
        jr      typeout
...
rq_read:                                ; the length is set each time
        FNREQ   DEV_NETWORK, NET_READ, F_B12, 0,0,0,0
        FNBUF   0, 0, buf, BUFSZ

ld      hl,rq_opbin             ; the same file again, but
        call    fn_call
        ld      hl,2048                 ;   READ with no STATUS first:
        ld      (rq_read+RQ_AUX1),hl    ;   the GET goes out, and READ
        ld      hl,rq_read              ;   waits for all 2048 bytes
        call    fn_call
        call    pcount
        ld      hl,rq_read              ; ask for 2048 again: only 952
        call    fn_call                 ;   are left, and they come
        call    pcount

ld      hl,rq_st8               ; the listing's length
        call    fn_call
        ld      hl,rq_rd8               ; read it: a line a file
        call    getwait

...

        FNBUF   0, 0, nstat, 4
rq_rd8:

        FNBUF   0, 0, buf, BUFSZ

ld      hl,64                   ; a READ past the end
        ld      (rq_read+RQ_AUX1),hl
        ld      hl,rq_read
